params.name: customer_id
params.description: The [customer](entity:Customer) for whom to retrieve bookings. If this is not set, bookings for all customers are retrieved.

params.name: team_member_id
params.description: The team member for whom to retrieve bookings. If this is not set, bookings of all members are retrieved.

params.name: location_id
params.description: The location for which to retrieve bookings. If this is not set, all locations' bookings are retrieved.

params.name: start_at_min
params.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp specifying the earliest of the start time. If this is not set, the current time is used.

params.name: start_at_max
params.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp specifying the latest of the start time. If this is not set, the time of 31 days after `start_at_min` is used.

Retrieve a collection of bookings.

To call this endpoint with buyer-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.
To call this endpoint with seller-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_ALL_READ` and `APPOINTMENTS_READ` for the OAuth scope.

Creates a booking.

The required input must include the following:
- `Booking.location_id`
- `Booking.start_at`
- `Booking.AppointmentSegment.team_member_id`
- `Booking.AppointmentSegment.service_variation_id`
- `Booking.AppointmentSegment.service_variation_version`

To call this endpoint with buyer-level permissions, set `APPOINTMENTS_WRITE` for the OAuth scope.
